reason: A curated DeepSeek Harness distribution for interactive and headless coding-agent workflows, combining project editing, code intelligence, MCP integration, web fetching, debugging, and reusable skills.

summaries.zh: 面向开发者的 DeepSeek Harness 精选发行版，提供交互式和无头编码代理、代码智能、项目编辑、MCP 集成及可选调试能力。
summaries.en: A curated DeepSeek Harness distribution for interactive and headless coding agents with code intelligence, project editing, MCP integration, and optional debugging.

capabilities: Runs an interactive or headless coding-agent environment
Reads and reuses local agent instructions, skills, hooks, and MCP configurations
Performs workspace file edits including approval-gated semantic renames
Fetches web content through a configured web-fetch provider
Can activate MCP servers and curated external integrations
Provides optional debugging, persistent code kernels, and desktop notifications
